source_of_truth: Derived by hand from the build I wrote: /orphan is listed in routes-manifest.json (staticRoutes) but there is no .next/server/app/orphan/page_client-reference-manifest.js, so the build exposes no client-chunk set for it. route-attribution genuinely cannot attribute initial JS to this route. The honest answer is route-attribution-unavailable [info] with a reason — this is a limit of the artifact, NOT a defect. A correct auditor must raise no defect-level finding here; the initial-weight heuristic cannot and must not fire without an initial set to measure.

forbidden.why_not_a_defect: there is no client-reference manifest, so no initial set exists to measure; any heavy-chunk claim would be invented out of missing data.
